local function AUUFF_fake_script() -- TextButton.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', TextButton)

	-- Reference to the button (replace 'ButtonName' with your actual button instance)
	local button = script.Parent -- Assuming this script is a child of the button
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	
	-- Function to safely get the RequestCommand RemoteEvent
	local function getRequestCommand()
		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient", 5):WaitForChild("Signals", 5):WaitForChild("RequestCommand", 5)
		end)
		if not success or not result then
			warn("Failed to find RequestCommand RemoteEvent: " .. tostring(result))
			return nil
		end
		return result
	end
	
	-- Connect button click event
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local RequestCommand = getRequestCommand()
		if RequestCommand then
			-- Invoke the server command (modify the command as needed)
			local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
				RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";give me btools") -- Grants building tools
			end)
			if not success then
				warn("Failed to invoke command: " .. tostring(errorMessage))
			end
		else
			warn("Cannot invoke command: RequestCommand not found")
		end
	end)
end
coroutine.wrap(AUUFF_fake_script)()
